from itertools import product

def solve(fixed, all_solutions=False):
    n=8; L=2*n
    # possible placements for each v: tuple positions (0-index)
    placements={}
    for v in range(1,n+1):
        d=v+1
        ps=[]
        for p in range(L-d):
            q=p+d
            # check fixed: if fixed pos has value v? positions covered by v ok, uncovered can't have fixed v? Actually all fixed of val v must be covered, no fixed other val in covered
            ok=True
            for pos,val in fixed.items():
                if pos in (p,q):
                    if val!=v: ok=False; break
                else:
                    if val==v: ok=False; break
            if ok: ps.append((p,q))
        placements[v]=ps
        print('v',v,'placements',ps)
    vals=sorted(range(1,n+1), key=lambda v: len(placements[v]))
    sol=[0]*L
    for pos,val in fixed.items(): sol[pos]=val
    res=[]
    def bt(i):
        if i==len(vals):
            if all(x for x in sol): res.append(sol.copy()); return not all_solutions
            return False
        v=vals[i]
        for p,q in placements[v]:
            if sol[p] not in (0,v) or sol[q] not in (0,v): continue
            # Need if fixed positions p/q assigned v okay. count? sol can contain fixed v at one position; set both
            oldp,oldq=sol[p],sol[q]
            sol[p]=sol[q]=v
            if bt(i+1): return True
            sol[p],sol[q]=oldp,oldq
        return False
    bt(0)
    return res[:5]
